aesthetic: Warm Minimalist Luxe, Cozy Coffeehouse, High-End Specialty Cafe

headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, Editorial quotes, and major section titles. Apply tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).

body.usage: Paragraphs, labels, menu items, and UI elements. Ensure high legibility with relaxed line-height (leading-relaxed).

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with a subtle border (border-white/40) for sticky navs and floating elements.
visual_enhancers.motion: Implement Framer Motion for scroll reveals, staggered entry animations, and a signature kinetic hero with masked line-by-line reveal.
visual_enhancers.smooth_scrolling: MANDATORY: Integrate Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling across the entire site.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft, ambient layered shadows. Avoid harsh drop shadows. Use tailwind's shadow-sm or custom ambient shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: Delicate 1px borders (#F3EDE6) to define cards and menu items.
visual_enhancers.imagery_treatment: Spotlight framing, clipped masks for product photos, and subtle parallax effects on scroll. Do not use generic full-width blanket overlays—use gradients or soft tints to preserve image detail.

layout_strategy.grid: Use asymmetrical 'Bento' grids and 'The Swiss Grid' for layout tension. Avoid standard symmetric 50/50 splits.
layout_strategy.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-12, p-16, py-24, py-32 for section padding to give an airy, luxurious feel.
layout_strategy.mobile_first: Ensure responsive behavior with a mobile drawer nav and optimized grid-cols-1 for small screens.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Lenis for smooth scrolling and Framer Motion for animations.
2. Implement a sticky glassmorphism navigation bar with a Pure Veg badge and 'Reserve Table' CTA.
3. Build the Hero Section with a masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion, and include the 3 images (Latte, Toast, Croissant) in a creative clipped/overlapping gallery layout.
4. Create the 'Our Story & Craft' section with numbered editorial manifesto chapters and the barista image.
5. Develop the Interactive Digital Menu with 10 category tabs, a live search bar, and mock data for ~80 items. Use Shadcn Tabs and Inputs.
6. Add a slow editorial marquee (e.g., 'ARTISANAL COFFEE • FRESH SOURDOUGH • 100% PURE VEG') using react-fast-marquee.
7. Include a static Google Reviews slider showcasing 3 high-quality testimonials.
8. Build a Location & Contact Widget with an embedded Google Map, timings, and a 'Table Reservation' dialog. The dialog must compose a WhatsApp deep link (wa.me/919561166185).
9. Ensure all interactive and key informational elements have 'data-testid' attributes.
10. Connect the frontend with the FastAPI backend for the menu data if applicable, or build robust mock data in the frontend if backend integration is deferred.
11. Use Playfair Display for headings and Plus Jakarta Sans for body text. Add the Google Fonts import to index.html or index.css.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' AI outputs. Create depth through layered design and z-index hierarchy.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all). Add transitions to specific interactive elements.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Every interaction needs micro-animations: hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than usual for a luxurious, uncluttered feel.
Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG contrast standards.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or floating headers.
